verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an HTTPS SFU API for controlling which endpoints publish or receive media, plus host moderation permissions in RealtimeKit. These are building blocks or client-side role controls. Nothing documents a server-side API that lists sessions, mutes or removes participants, or ends a session without a client.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
